user.title: Configure Extended Web Search
user.description: Set up the extended web search integration. This requires a running SearXNG instance.

data_description.searxng_url: URL of your SearXNG server (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8080). JSON output must be enabled.
data_description.num_results: Number of search result pages to fetch content from
data_description.max_content_length: Maximum total characters of page content returned to the LLM per tool call. Roughly 4 characters are one token.
data_description.request_timeout: Overall time limit for one search, including fetching all pages

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Extended Web Search is allowed.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full http:// or https:// URL.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SearXNG server.
error.json_disabled: SearXNG did not return JSON. Enable the json format under search.formats in settings.yml.
